| 论文引用 | 实际计算 | 来源 |
|---------|---------|------|
| "6.7% over scalar" | (0.078799−0.073478)/0.078799 = **6.75%** | B vs A total MSE |
| "16.7% over no uncertainty" | (0.088223−0.073478)/0.088223 = **16.71%** | B vs C total MSE |
| "22-24% improvements" | y: **22.79%**, z: **23.90%** | B vs A per-axis MSE |
